# Free house plan generator: describe a home, download the whole plan set

> Generate a free house plan from a sentence: floor plan, elevations, 3D model (IFC, OBJ), CAD (DXF), bill of materials and a cost estimate. 1 to 5 bedrooms, farmhouse, craftsman, modern, ranch and cottage styles. Public domain, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
